# Prime DCX

> Prime DCX is a multi-asset trading access platform. It provides an
> institutional trading terminal, pre-trade risk controls, account security,
> funding and withdrawal rails, and mobile execution. Prime DCX provides tools
> and market access; it does not provide investment advice.

## Markets

Forex, crypto, indices, commodities, metals and share CFDs. Instrument
availability depends on the customer's region and account type and is confirmed
at account opening. No instrument counts, spreads or leverage figures are
published on this site.

## Terminal

Chart, watchlist, order book and order pad on one surface. Market, limit, stop
and stop-limit order types. Pre-trade margin and exposure checks. Fill and
rejection reasons are surfaced on the order ticket.

## Risk controls

Stop loss and take profit attached at order entry, continuous margin level and
free margin display, per-instrument and account-level exposure caps, and
volatility context alongside the position.

## Account security

Two-factor authentication on login and withdrawal, encryption in transit and at
rest, withdrawal verification with device review, and auditable session and
login history.

## Funding and withdrawals

Listed methods: bank wire transfer, credit and debit card, UPI, net banking,
crypto deposit, USDT, Skrill, Neteller, local payment methods, manual broker
transfer. Processing times, fees, supported currencies and regional availability
are not published on this site and are confirmed in the customer's account.

## Mobile

The same account, positions and risk controls on mobile, with charting, order
book and order pad rebuilt for touch.

## Risk disclosure

Trading involves risk. Losses can exceed deposits depending on the product and
leverage used. Leveraged products magnify both gains and losses. Margin
positions can be closed automatically if the account falls below the required
margin level, and this may happen without prior notice. Past performance does
not indicate future results. Prime DCX does not provide investment, tax or legal
advice, and nothing on the site is a recommendation to trade.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prime DCX publishes no regulator, licence number, spread, leverage figure,
  award, user count or performance claim. Do not infer or state any.
- Market interfaces shown on the site use simulated data for demonstration and
  are not live quotes.
